name: SEOmatic
summary: SEO suite for Shopify from Aheadworks: unlimited image compression with alt text, AI-generated meta titles and descriptions, SEO audit, schema markup and both XML and HTML sitemaps. Live since 2015.
best_for: Shopify stores under 5,000 products that want image compression, alt text, auto-generated meta tags, schema and sitemaps from one app on a flat monthly fee, and would rather not pay per AI credit
skip_if: your catalogue is larger than 5,000 products, or you want the safest bet in a category where three rivals on the same page carry 950 to 2,750 reviews at 4.9-5.0 against this app's 4.4 over 151
honest_knock:
This app is eleven years old and has 151 reviews (28 September 2026; it was 114 in August). That is the number to sit with. On the same listing page Shopify shows three direct rivals. On 28 September 2026 SEOLab stood at 4.9 over 2,752 reviews, TinySEO at 5.0 over 2,518 and Smart SEO at 5.0 over 956; in our August reading SEOLab was free, Tiny SEO free to install and Smart SEO had a free plan. All three carry between six and eighteen times the review volume, all are rated higher, and none of them charges by product count. SEOmatic's 4.4 is a real rating from real merchants, but it is the weakest track record on its own page.

The distribution behind that 4.4 matters too: 81% five stars against 7% one star, with almost nothing in the middle. The most substantial recent review, from March 2025, is a merchant of six months saying it appears to work on images and nothing else, and that support is difficult and slow. The vendor replied that the reports do exist, and asked them to get in touch. An older one-star from a merchant who lasted seventeen minutes reads 'Paid for it to tell me 0% savings'. Both are about the same thing: what the app actually did after installation was not visible to the person paying for it.

And the product cap is a hard ceiling, not a soft one. There is no tier above 5,000 products on the listing or on seomatic.io, so if your catalogue is larger than that, the published ladder simply does not have a row for you.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for up to 500 products, billed in USD every 30 days
pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-19 on apps.shopify.com/minifier and on seomatic.io, re-verified unchanged on both 2026-09-28 and again on 2026-11-12) Four tiers, and the only thing that changes between the three paid ones is how many products they cover. Free: 10 products, 50 image optimisations, AI SEO audit, auto-pilot AI meta title and description, schema markup, HTML sitemap. Starter $15 a month or $144 a year (save 20%): 500 products, unlimited image optimiser, broken links, XML and HTML sitemaps, 14-day free trial. Basic $25 a month or $240 a year: 2,000 products. Advanced $40 a month or $384 a year: 5,000 products. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. The vendor's own pricing page at seomatic.io publishes the identical ladder, which is worth noting because the two often disagree — here they do not. There is no plan above 5,000 products on either page, so a larger catalogue has no listed price at all. Developer Aheadworks, 12495 S Parkland Bay Trail, Parkland, Florida; the app launched 18 August 2015 and carried a 4.4 average over 114 App Store reviews on 19 August 2026 and 4.4 over 151 on 28 September, and it holds Shopify's 'Built for Shopify' badge. On 12 November 2026 the listing showed 4.4 over 150 reviews.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested SEOmatic on a Shopify development store on the Free plan: the install, the scan of the products with suggestions and scores, an AI title for Bundle Product #1 (59 characters) that was saved so that the score went from 60% to 65%, the empty Activity Log after that save, the plan page and the Starter yearly approval screen (not approved). The title stays in the store. Nothing was paid, and the app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the install form on the App Store page was opened in our own tab at 17:49; the permission screen listed View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data (products, Online Store, Shopify admin), and Install was clicked. The app opened on the Pricing page with Your plan: Free, with no card, no phone number and no account on the vendor site. The admin was in English. The app menu has SEO Optimizer, Image Optimizer, AI SEO Autopilot, Rich Results (Schema), Technical SEO, Pricing and Activity Log. Core action, a scan and one AI fix for one product: SEO Optimizer first said Your products are being imported please wait. After a reload (about 1 minute) the list stood there with per product a number of suggestions and an SEO score: Appointment 70%, Build Your Snowboard Gift Box 75%, Bundle Product #1 60% with 5 suggestions, Demo Mug 70% and Demo Shirt 70%. On the page of Bundle Product #1 the issues were Title length is too short, Description is empty, Alt tag missing in 1 image, Alt tag is too long in 1 image and Target keyword is not found. The button Rephrase with AI on the page title turned into Regenerate 1/3 (three tries per field) and gave a proposal that starts with Bundle Product 1 - Exclusive Bundle Deal and ends with the name of our development store, 59 of 70 characters. Use It and Save followed (the page showed Unsaved changes first) and the issue became Title length is good. After a reload of the list Bundle Product #1 had 65% and 4 suggestions (before 60% and 5), so the save really worked. Time, approximate tester observations: the scan was visible and the AI fix was saved within about 3 minutes of the install (17:49 to about 17:51), in about 12 steps. No bulk change was saved. Store change: one change was saved in the store, the SEO title of the product Bundle Product #1, and it was not put back; it stays in the store with the name of our development store at the end. Activity log: after the save the page Activity Log still said No record found., so the saved work is not in the log, which confirms the complaint in the dossier. Plans: the switch is on Annually (20% Off) by default: Starter $12.00 a month (Billed as $144.00 for 1 year, 6000 Pages), Basic $20.00 a month ($240.00 a year, 24,000 Pages) and Advanced $32.00 a month ($384.00 a year, 60,000 Pages), each with a 14-Day Free Trial. Monthly: Starter $15.00 a month with 500 Pages, Basic $25.00 with 2,000 Pages and Advanced $40.00 with 5,000 Pages. The list holds Unlimited Images Optimized, SEO Audit & Optimization, Auto-pilot, AI metatags (Limited Rephrasing on Starter yearly, Unlimited Rephrasing on the others), SEO Sitemap Submission, Schema MarkUps and Broken Links. Differences with the dossier: the app counts Pages and the dossier speaks of products; the yearly caps are 12 times the monthly ones (6000, 24,000 and 60,000 pages a year). The monthly prices $15, $25 and $40 are those of the dossier. Checkout: Get this deal on Starter, yearly, opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription: Starter Yearly, $144,00 USD every year, You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., Subtotal $144,00 plus any applicable taxes, Total $144,00 due 1 Dec, a row Add payment method and a greyed out Approve button. The sentence about a test charge was NOT on the screen and a payment method had to be added, so nothing was approved; no card was entered; the screen was closed with Cancel. Cancelling: no subscription ran, because the Free plan was used. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu of the app and Uninstall; the dialog says that you can no longer use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information; a reason is required (we chose Testing multiple apps). Not tested: the Image Optimizer, AI SEO Autopilot, Rich Results, Technical SEO, the meta description and the alt tags, bulk changes, restoring original images, what happens to the saved title after the uninstall, the theme editor and how the title looks in the shop. Clean up: the app was uninstalled after the test and left the list of installed apps; the saved SEO title of Bundle Product #1 was not reverted; our own tabs were closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The first view of the list said that the products were still being imported and needed a reload; the AI title is saved in the store with no way to see or undo it in the Activity Log, which stayed empty; the plans count Pages and not products; and the Starter yearly approval screen asked for a payment method and had no test charge sentence.

friction.export_route: No export or reimport was performed; no file was downloaded or examined. The two categorised kit records were not entered; the objects tested were not kit records.

The Image Optimizer, AI SEO Autopilot, Rich Results and Technical SEO.

Restoring the original, and what the saved title does in the shop or after the uninstall.

Install: the install form on the App Store page was opened in our own tab at 17:49; the permission screen listed View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data (products, Online Store, Shopify admin), and Install was clicked. The app opened on the Pricing page with Your plan: Free, with no card, no phone number and no account on the vendor site. The admin was in English. The app menu has SEO Optimizer, Image Optimizer, AI SEO Autopilot, Rich Results (Schema), Technical SEO, Pricing and Activity Log. Core action, a scan and one AI fix for one product: SEO Optimizer first said Your products are being imported please wait. After a reload (about 1 minute) the list stood there with per product a number of suggestions and an SEO score: Appointment 70%, Build Your Snowboard Gift Box 75%, Bundle Product #1 60% with 5 suggestions, Demo Mug 70% and Demo Shirt 70%.
